title: Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.26413v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference-time alignment methods, such as Best-of-N (BoN), improve language model outputs by generating multiple candidates per prompt and selecting among them using a reward model. Much of this cost is wasted: a fixed budget is applied to every prompt, although the computation required by prompts varies widely. Adaptive methods halt once sampled answers appear settled, but their thresholds are tuned heuristics with no statistical control over early-stopping errors. We instead seek an anytime-valid stopping rule that takes an error tolerance $\alpha$ as input and halts only once an answer is certified to hold a majority ($\theta_a > 1/2$) under the generator's distribution. We aggregate candidates by final answer with a reward-weighted self-consistency (RWSC) score and treat stopping as a sequential test over the resulting clusters. Applying Wald's sequential probability ratio test to these clusters yields SPRT-RWSC, which performs well

translated_title: 用于高效推理时对齐的序列化任意时有效检验
translated_abstract: 推理时对齐方法，如 Best-of-N (BoN)，通过为每个提示生成多个候选答案并使用奖励模型从中选择，来改进语言模型的输出。这种方法中大量计算成本被浪费：每个提示都被施加了固定的预算，尽管不同提示所需的计算量差异巨大。现有的自适应方法在采样答案看起来已经稳定时就停止，但其阈值是启发式调优的，对提前停止产生的错误缺乏统计控制。我们转而寻求一种任意时有效的停止规则，该规则以错误容忍度 α 作为输入，只有当答案在生成器分布下被认证为占多数（θ_a > 1/2）时才停止。我们使用奖励加权自一致性（RWSC）分数按最终答案聚合候选，并将停止问题转化为对这些聚类结果的序列化检验。将 Wald 序列概率比检验应用于这些聚类，得到了 SPRT-RWSC 方法，其表现良好。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于奖励加权自一致性分数与 Wald 序列概率比检验的任意时有效停止规则 SPRT-RWSC，能在给定错误容忍度下统计可控地高效判定推理时对齐中的多数答案，避免固定预算造成的计算浪费。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPRT-RWSC, an anytime-valid stopping rule combining reward-weighted self-consistency scores with Wald's sequential probability ratio test, enabling statistically controlled and efficient certification of majority answers in inference-time alignment while avoiding the waste of fixed per-prompt budgets.
